messages:
Hector Morales: Quick heads-up  we have a short onboarding index backlog affecting imports created between 05:15-05:45 UTC. Need an external note + AM escalation list. Keep it punchy.
Ariel Bernstein: I can draft. Two short paras: what happened, ETA, manual retry steps, assurance, and a goodwill credit + optional help session.
Sam Park: Workaround details: Console > Indexes > Reindex or API: POST /v1/indexes/:id/reindex. Also a note that this is queueing/backlog not deletion.
Nadia El-Amin: Please include a line: "No customer data was exposed or altered." And flag renewal-risk customers created in that window for AM outreach.
cs-automation: infra-bot: rollout-3001 started at 2025-06-10T05:50:00Z, progress: 3/7 nodes.
Ariel Bernstein: Draft copy: `Hi  We detected a short processing backlog affecting some new tenant imports created 05:15-05:45 UTC. Engineers deployed a fix and backlog processing is underway; we expect full catch-up within approximately 3 hours. If you need immediate access to newly indexed documents, trigger a manual reindex in Console > Indexes > Reindex or call POST /v1/indexes/:id/reindex. No customer data was exposed or altered. As a courtesy we will apply a one-time credit equal to one day of ingestion charges and offer a complimentary 30-minute onboarding review. Reply "review" to opt in or book: https://cal.redwood.com/cs-review. For urgent help contact cs@redwood.ai.`
Hector Morales: Swap wording to "complimentary 30-minute onboarding review" (nice). Add quick feedback link after send: https://tiny.redwood.com/cs-feedback (Yes/No).
billing-bot: billing-bot: provisional credit record created for affected tenants; will post after confirmation.
cs-automation: infra-bot: rollout-3001 update: progress: 7/7 nodes, status: success at 2025-06-10T05:54:12Z. Backlog drain rate increased x2.5.
Sam Park: Confirmed processing rate increased; projected catch-up by 08:10 UTC. I'll export impacted-tenant list and tag AMs for renewal-risk follow-up.
Ariel Bernstein: I'll create Intercom campaign and targeted enterprise emails. Will paste campaign id and final copy here once sent.
Hector Morales: Owners: Ariel outbound & Intercom, Sam impacted list & AM pings, Nadia verify credits posted. After send, capture feedback and coach opt-ins into tenant-health. Close once credits are posted and AMs acknowledged.
Ariel Bernstein: Intercom campaign created id=IC-20250610-09 and outbound sent to affected segment. Final copy posted above. Feedback link appended.
Sam Park: Impacted tenant export shared with AMs (spreadsheet link internal). Notifying high-risk accounts.
billing-bot: billing-bot: credits queued; posting scheduled in next billing window.
Nadia El-Amin: Early feedback: 14 Yes / 3 No; 5 opted into review in first hour. Adding to tenant-health/2025-06-imports.
Hector Morales: Thanks team. Please paste the Intercom id and credit-post confirmation here when complete; we'll close thread after final tally. :handshake:
